nav.searchLabel.source: Search teams, competitions, players, news, groups and members

common.unreachable.source: The service is unreachable right now.

error.notFound.body.source: There is no page at this address. It may have moved, or the link may be mistyped.

error.failed.title.source: This page could not be shown

error.failed.body.source: Something went wrong while building this page. Trying again usually works; the rest of the site is still here.

theme.hint.source: Device follows the light or dark setting of your phone or computer. Your choice is kept in this browser and on your account, so signing in elsewhere brings it with you.

appearance.hint.source: Larger text makes every size on the page bigger. More contrast darkens secondary text and edges so all text reaches the highest readability standard. Reduced motion stops animations. Device follows the setting of your phone or computer.

appearance.guest.source: Sign in to change your profile, privacy, following and viewing territory. Your appearance choices are kept in this browser, and on your account once you sign in.

account.delete.removed.source: Deleting your account signs you out on every device and removes your e-mail address, password, display name, biography, preferences, follows, friendships, blocks, group memberships and invitations, and your push subscriptions.

account.delete.kept.source: Your messages and match panel posts stay where they were written, shown as by a deleted member. Your published community analysis is taken down. Your predictions and their settlements stay as records without your name, because other members' ratings were computed against them. Reports you made are kept for the moderation record.

account.delete.username.source: Your username is retired: nobody can register it after you. A group you own passes to its longest-standing moderator, or member; a group with nobody else in it is closed.

account.delete.confirmHint.source: Type {username} exactly as it is written here.

account.deleted.body.source: Your account was deleted and every session was signed out. Your predictions remain as records without your name.

account.export.contents.source: One file (JSON) of what this site holds about you: your account and preferences, follows, friendships, groups, every version of your predictions and how they settled, your rating history and achievements, saved stories, the messages and match panel posts you wrote, your community analysis, the reports you filed and the notifications sent to you.

account.export.others.source: Only your own words and rows are in it: never another member's messages, name or predictions. A conversation shows only what you wrote.

account.export.once.source: One file a day. It downloads here, in this browser, and is never sent by e-mail.

account.export.refused.password.source: That password is not right. No file was made.

account.export.refused.daily.source: You downloaded a copy less than a day ago. The next one is possible a day after that.

account.export.refused.limited.source: Too many wrong passwords. Wait a while and try again.

account.export.refused.signed_out.source: Your session has ended. Sign in again to download your data.

account.export.refused.unavailable.source: The service is unreachable right now. No file was made.

language.name.ar.note: The language's own name: a fact, not a translation of the English.

languageHold.notice.source: this language is held back for now, so FMIP is shown in English. Your choice is kept, and applies again when the language returns.

source.one: {count} member did not call this match.
source.other: {count} members did not call this match.

viewing.pageLead.source: Official services for each match, in the territory you choose. Nothing is guessed from your address, and a territory nobody has covered says so.

viewing.ask.source: Choose your territory to see where this match is shown. It is never guessed from your address.

viewing.nothingListed.source: No official service listed for this match in

viewing.unreachable.source: The viewing service is unreachable right now, so where to watch cannot be shown.

viewing.desk.lead.source: Listings are entered by hand from public schedules, link-only, and every entry is recorded with your name. Declare coverage for a territory before listing anything in it.

viewing.desk.territoryHint.source: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, such as GB or IR.

viewing.desk.stateAvailable.source: Covered: what is listed is what there is

viewing.desk.note.source: Which schedule you are working from

viewing.desk.listing.source: List this match on a service

viewing.desk.noBroadcasters.source: No broadcasters yet. Add one below before listing.

summary.label.source: Written by a language model from the match record, not by a person. Not the founder's analysis, not the statistical forecast, not the community's view.

summary.reason.notFinished.source: A summary is written from the full record, after the match.

summary.reason.noModel.source: No language model is configured on this deployment, so there is no machine-written summary.

summary.reason.notGenerated.source: No summary has been written for this match yet.

summary.reason.rejected.source: The last attempt was turned down by the grounding check and is not shown.

summary.reason.thinRecord.source: The record of this match holds only the score, so there is no summary: nothing else would be from the record.

summary.unreachable.source: The summary service is unreachable right now.

search.reason.noModel.source: No language model is configured, so this is a keyword search.

search.reason.unreadable.source: The question could not be read as one, so it was searched as keywords.

search.reason.nothingNamed.source: The question names nothing the search could look for, so it was searched as keywords.

search.reason.failed.source: The language model could not be reached, so this is a keyword search.

search.empty.group.source: No group that can be found matches. Invite-only groups are never listed.

search.empty.member.source: No member with a public profile matches. Private and friends-only profiles are never listed.

search.communityUnreachable.source: News, groups and members cannot be searched right now.

briefing.label.source: Written by a language model from your feed, not by a person, and only about what is in it.

briefing.reason.noModel.source: No language model is configured on this deployment; your feed below is the briefing.

briefing.reason.nothingToBrief.source: Nothing happened around what you follow in this window, so there is nothing to brief.

briefing.reason.notWritten.source: No briefing has been written yet. Ask for one and it is written from the feed below.

briefing.reason.rejected.source: The last attempt was turned down by the check that holds it to your feed, and is not shown.

briefing.unreachable.source: The briefing service is unreachable right now.

news.related.nothing.source: No publisher has reported on this match or its sides in the week around it.

news.entity.nothingTeam.source: No publisher we read has reported on this team yet.

news.entity.nothingCompetition.source: No publisher we read has reported on this competition yet.

news.entity.nothingPlayer.source: No publisher we read has reported on this player yet.

news.entity.personsUnlinked.source: Stories are not linked to players yet, so this list cannot say whether anyone has written about this one.

source.one: None of the publishers we read has written about this competition in the last {count} day, so this is not a picture of its news.
source.other: None of the publishers we read has written about this competition in the last {count} days, so this is not a picture of its news.

source.one: Only {count} story about this competition from the publishers we read in the last {days} days: our coverage of it is thin.
source.other: Only {count} stories about this competition from the publishers we read in the last {days} days: our coverage of it is thin.

player.availability.noTeam.source: No current team on record, so there is no next match to read availability for.

player.availability.noNextMatch.source: No scheduled match ahead for this team in our records.

player.availability.fromLineup.source: Team taken from the latest line-up that names this player.

player.availability.notAsked.source: The feed has not yet been asked who will miss this match. It is asked in the three days before kick-off.

player.availability.notListed.source: Not on the feed's list of players who will or may miss this match. The feed never confirms that a player is fit.

player.availability.stale.source: This answer is more than six hours old and may have changed.

news.filter.unavailable.source: Some filter lists could not be loaded.

source.one: {count} story that matches the other filters has no type, so it is not shown.
source.other: {count} stories that match the other filters have no type, so they are not shown.

news.neverRead.source: The feeds have not been read yet.

news.stale.source: The feeds have not been read for a while, so this list may be behind.

news.unreachable.source: The news service is unreachable right now, so nothing can be shown.

news.reason.discussionAndSaves.source: Trending counts members discussing a story's matches and members saving the story in the last 48 hours, one each. Views and shares are not measured.

news.reason.nothingTrending.source: Nothing has been discussed in the last two days.

news.reason.nothingSelected.source: Editors have not selected any debates yet.

news.reason.needsSession.source: Sign in to see stories about what you follow.

news.reason.nothingFollowed.source: You follow nothing yet. Follow a team or a competition to see its stories here.

news.noTime.source: time not given by the publisher

source.one: {count} member in the match discussion in the last {hours} hours
source.other: {count} members in the match discussion in the last {hours} hours

source.one: {count} member saved it in the last {hours} hours
source.other: {count} members saved it in the last {hours} hours

news.breaking.noteLabel.source: What is breaking (readers see this on the homepage)

news.reason.nothingYet.source: No stories have been read from any publisher yet.

news.reason.personsUnlinked.source: Stories are not linked to players yet, so this list cannot say whether there is news about this player.

news.debate.noteLabel.source: Why this is a debate (readers see this)

story.bodyAtSource.source: This publisher grants the headline and summary here; the article itself is on their site.

story.translationStatus.source: Each language is either the publisher’s own version or a translation a fluent speaker wrote and a second one reviewed. Nothing here is machine-translated.

story.noEntities.source: No team, competition or match has been linked to this story.

story.noOtherReports.source: No other publisher has reported this story.

story.follow.title.source: Follow what this story is about

story.follow.signIn.source: Sign in to follow these teams and competitions.

story.follow.unavailable.source: Your follows could not be read just now, so they cannot be changed here.

story.predictions.intro.source: Three separate products, each on the match centre under its own name. None is shown here, and they are never combined.

story.predictions.modelNote.source: probabilities from the versioned statistical model

story.predictions.founderNote.source: one person's signed view, not the model

story.predictions.communityNote.source: what members predicted, published from five predictors

story.version.translated.source: translated by a fluent speaker, awaiting review

story.version.reviewed.source: translated and reviewed by two fluent speakers

story.type.none.source: No type: neither the publisher's category nor an editor gave this story one.

feed.unreachable.source: Your feed cannot be shown right now.

source.one: {count} member discussing in the last {hours} hours
source.other: {count} members discussing in the last {hours} hours

feed.reason.nothingFollowed.source: You follow nothing yet. Follow a team, a competition or a contributor and what happens around them will appear here.

feed.reason.nothingInWindow.source: Nothing has happened around what you follow in the last week, and nothing is due in the next.

feed.nextSteps.intro.source: Follow one of the competitions below, or a team that plays in it. Its matches, news and analysis will then appear on this page.

feed.nextSteps.ranked.source: Teams in this season, most followed first:

feed.nextSteps.noTeams.source: No fixture of this season names a team yet.

feed.nextSteps.nothingHeld.source: The site holds no competitions yet, so there is nothing to suggest.

feed.nextSteps.unreachable.source: Suggestions cannot be loaded right now.

feed.nextSteps.search.source: Search for a team, a player or a competition

feed.nextSteps.everything.source: Choose from every team and competition in Settings

firstRun.intro.source: Four short questions, each one skippable. You can change every answer later in Settings.

firstRun.guestNote.source: You are not signed in, so your answers are kept in this browser and saved to your account when you register or sign in.

firstRun.language.onlyOne.source: FMIP speaks English for now. Other languages are offered here once their translation is finished, and not before.

firstRun.territory.hint.source: Rights are sold by country, so this decides which viewing options you are shown. It is the country you are in, not the team you support.

firstRun.territory.unreachable.source: The territory list cannot be loaded right now. Skip this step and choose later in Settings.

firstRun.timezone.question.source: Which time zone should kick-off times be shown in?

firstRun.timezone.browser.source: Your device reports the time zone

firstRun.timezone.confirm.source: It is selected below: save to confirm it, or choose another.

firstRun.teams.hint.source: Favourites are pinned first on the scores page and followed on your Following page.

firstRun.teams.unreachable.source: The team list cannot be loaded right now. Skip this step and choose later in Settings.

firstRun.offer.text.source: Make FMIP yours: choose a language, where you watch from, your time zone and your favourite teams. Every step can be skipped.

achievements.none.source: No achievements yet. They are earned by predicting matches and having the predictions settled.

achievements.restrictedFriends.source: Achievements are visible to friends only.

achievements.unreachable.source: The achievements cannot be shown right now.

achievements.note.source: Achievements record taking part. They never change the rating, a leaderboard position or a privilege.

groupSettings.policy.owner_and_moderator.source: The owner and the group's moderators

groupSettings.policy.hint.source: The change is recorded in the group's history. A link somebody made stops working if the new choice leaves them out.

groupSettings.policy.done.source: Saved. The change is in the group's history.

groupSettings.about.favourite.source: The club or competition the group is about

groupSettings.about.listUnavailable.source: The list of clubs and competitions cannot be shown right now, so the favourite stays as it is.

groupSettings.links.hint.source: Anyone holding a live link can follow it until it expires, is used up or is revoked. Blocks, sanctions and the e-mail check apply to them as to an invitation.

groupSettings.links.unreachable.source: The invite links cannot be shown right now.

groupSettings.links.state.orphaned.source: Not working: its maker may no longer invite

groupSettings.links.revoked.source: Revoked. The link no longer works.

groupSettings.links.maxUses.source: How many people it lets in

groupSettings.links.created.source: Made. Copy it now: it is shown only this once.

groupSettings.links.copyFailed.source: Copying did not work here. Select the link and copy it yourself.

groupSettings.history.intro.source: Every recorded change to this group, newest first: who made it, when, why, and what it was before. Nobody can edit this list.

groupSettings.history.unreachable.source: The history cannot be shown right now.

groupSettings.history.action.rules.source: A new version of the rules

groupPolls.unreachable.source: The polls cannot be shown right now.

groupPolls.none.source: No polls yet. Ask the group something below.

groupPolls.noNames.source: Polls show counts only. Who voted is never shown, to anyone.

groupPolls.hiddenUntilVoted.source: The counts are shown once you have voted, or when the poll closes.

groupPolls.removeReason.source: Why remove it (recorded with the removal)

groupPolls.optionsHint.source: Two to six answers; leave the rest empty.

groupPolls.limitReached.source: This group has three open polls. A new one can be asked when one closes or is removed.

notifications.match.intro.source: For the matches you follow, and the matches of the teams and competitions you follow. Alerts from the same minute arrive together, a goal taken off the board is corrected, and nothing arrives twice.

notifications.match.availability.source: Team news: a player ruled out of the match

notifications.match.goal.source: Goals, and a correction when one is taken off the board

notifications.match.quiet.source: To silence one team or one competition, or every match alert at once, use What stays quiet below. Quiet hours hold match alerts too.

match.follow.note.source: Its alerts reach you under your match alert settings, once each even if you follow its teams too. The follow ends by itself three hours after full-time.

match.follow.following.source: You follow this match. The follow ends by itself three hours after full-time.

match.follow.over.source: This match is over, so it can no longer be followed.

match.follow.signIn.source: Sign in to follow this match

match.follow.unreachable.source: Whether you follow this match cannot be checked right now.

scores.metaDescription.source: Live scores and fixtures, one day at a time in your time zone.

scores.timesInGuest.source: Times in {zone} (sign in for your own zone)

scores.signInFavourites.source: Sign in to filter by your favourites.

scores.unreachable.source: The scores service is unreachable right now, so nothing can be shown for this day.

scores.feed.failure.source: The live data feed reported a failure at {time}. Scores may be behind; every card shows when its data last changed.

scores.feed.partial.source: The live data feed reported a partial update at {time}. Scores may be behind; every card shows when its data last changed.

scores.filteredEmpty.source: No match on this day fits these filters.

scores.card.behind.source: Data behind: nothing has changed since {time}. The score shown is the last known, not the current one.

scores.card.noSchedule.source: no schedule covers this match in {territory}.

scores.card.unreachable.source: could not be loaded for this page.

scores.card.lineUnreachable.source: could not be loaded for this page. The match centre has it.

scores.card.lineNotLoaded.source: not loaded for this list. The match centre has it.

scores.card.model.version.source: the statistical model, version {version}, computed {time}, before kick-off

scores.card.model.couldNotAnswer.source: The model could not answer for this match.

scores.card.model.noneBefore.source: the model had no forecast for this match before kick-off.

scores.card.model.notYet.source: the model has not forecast this match yet.

source.one: not published until {count} member has predicted this match.
source.other: not published until {count} members have predicted this match.

matchCentre.metaDescription.source: {home} v {away}: {competition} {season}, kick-off {kickoff}. Line-ups, timeline, statistics, form, forecast and predictions.

matchCentre.unreachable.source: The match service is unreachable right now, so this match cannot be shown.

matchCentre.behind.source: The data for this match is behind: nothing has changed since {time}. The score and minute shown are the last known, not the current ones.

matchCentre.moduleDelayed.source: Data for this module is delayed.

matchCentre.xgNotSupplied.source: Expected goals (xG): the provider did not supply them for this match.

matchCentre.playerXgNotSupplied.source: Expected goals per player: not supplied by the provider for any match.

matchCentre.noAbsences.source: Nobody is reported missing or doubtful.

matchCentre.noAbsencesAsked.source: Nobody is reported missing or doubtful (asked {time}).

matchCentre.context.unreachable.source: The competition service could not be reached, so the table and the round cannot be shown.

matchCentre.context.form.source: Form in this competition, latest first:

matchCentre.context.levelAbove.source: Level on points with the place above

matchCentre.context.levelBelow.source: Level on points with the place below

matchCentre.context.noneCounted.source: No match of this table was played before this one, so there are no positions yet.

source.one: From the {count} finished match of this table played before kick-off.
source.other: From the {count} finished matches of this table played before kick-off.

matchCentre.context.places.source: Where the qualification, promotion and relegation places fall is not in our records, so no gap to them is shown.

matchCentre.context.legsUnknown.source: Whether this round has a second leg is not in our records

matchCentre.context.notJudged.source: Not judged: the number of legs is not in our records.

matchCentre.context.tableDelayed.source: The table for this competition is delayed.

matchCentre.context.noTable.source: No table from before this match is in our records.

matchCentre.context.friendly.source: A friendly: no table or round to place it in.

matchCentre.context.neither.source: Neither a table nor a knockout round for this match is in our records.

matchCentre.keyPlayers.unreachable.source: The key players could not be reached, so they cannot be shown.

matchCentre.keyPlayers.notAsked.source: Availability: the provider has not been asked about this match, so none is claimed.

matchCentre.keyPlayers.asked.source: Availability as the provider gave it, {time}.

matchCentre.keyPlayers.delayed.source: Player figures for this side are delayed.

matchCentre.keyPlayers.noFigures.source: No per-match player figures for this side this season.

source.one: Key players are each side's {count} with the most minutes in {competition} {season} before this match, counted from the feed's per-match player figures; a tie on minutes goes to more goals plus assists, then the name. Goals and assists are summed from the same figures. This is a count, not a judgement of quality, and no rating is used.
source.other: Key players are each side's {count} with the most minutes in {competition} {season} before this match, counted from the feed's per-match player figures; a tie on minutes goes to more goals plus assists, then the name. Goals and assists are summed from the same figures. This is a count, not a judgement of quality, and no rating is used.

matchCentre.keyPlayers.notListed.source: Not on the provider’s absence list

matchCentre.keyPlayers.noneYet.source: No match of this competition played before this one, so no minutes to count yet.

source.one: From player figures for {with} of {count} match played: the other matches have none, so these totals are a floor.
source.other: From player figures for {with} of {count} matches played: the other matches have none, so these totals are a floor.

source.one: From player figures for all {count} match played.
source.other: From player figures for all {count} matches played.

matchCentre.community.unreachable.source: The prediction service is unreachable right now, so what the community thinks cannot be shown.

source.one: Fewer than {count} member has predicted this match, so there is no consensus to show yet.
source.other: Fewer than {count} members have predicted this match, so there is no consensus to show yet.

matchCentre.community.intro.source: What registered members predicted. Not the statistical model, and not the founder.

matchCentre.community.weightedAbsent.source: None of the members who predicted this match has an established rating yet, so there is nothing to weight by. This is not the same as the distribution above.

matchCentre.community.gapNote.source: percentage points, community against model. These are two separate answers to the same question; the site does not average them.

matchCentre.community.lastPrediction.source: Last prediction {time}. Members may keep predicting until kick-off.

source.one: No match here has {count} prediction yet, so there is no consensus to show.
source.other: No match here has {count} predictions yet, so there is no consensus to show.

forecast.unreachable.source: The forecast service could not be reached, so no forecast can be shown.

forecast.none.source: No forecast has been computed for this match yet.

forecast.couldNotProduce.source: The model could not produce a forecast.

forecast.evaluation.correct.source: Version {version} ({kind}) gave that outcome {probability}, its most probable outcome.

forecast.evaluation.incorrect.source: Version {version} ({kind}) gave that outcome {probability}, not its most probable outcome.

forecast.evaluation.scores.source: Log loss {logLoss}, Brier {brier} (lower is better; knowing nothing scores 1.099 and 0.667).

forecast.evaluation.afterKickoff.source: Computed after kick-off, so excluded from performance figures.

forecast.noEloPrior.source: No Elo prior this time: the long-term ratings were not available when this version was computed, so team strength rests on results alone.

forecast.reason.teamNotMapped.source: The model does not know one of the teams yet.

forecast.reason.noHistory.source: The model has too little match history for one of the teams.

forecast.reason.divisionNotLoaded.source: This competition's history is not loaded into the model.

forecast.reason.competitionNotMapped.source: This competition's history is not in the model's training data.

forecast.reason.crossCompetition.source: The model rates clubs within one league; a match between clubs of different leagues waits for its next version.

forecast.reason.modelUnreachable.source: The model service could not be reached when this version was computed.

forecast.reason.contractViolation.source: The model's answer did not match the contract and was not used.

forecast.framing.close.source: The model sees this as close: {side} is ahead by {margin} points, which is within the noise of a football match.

forecast.framing.clear.source: The model gives {side} the most probability, {margin} points ahead of the next outcome. Every outcome remains possible; these are probabilities, not a prediction of the result.

forecast.attribution.noInputs.source: The {kind} version reported no inputs, so nothing can be attributed.

forecast.attribution.lineupCaveat.source: The model does not read line-ups yet, so this version is one computed when the line-up was confirmed, not one computed from it.

forecast.attribution.nothing.source: Nothing the model reads changed between these two versions.

forecast.attribution.one.source: Only one input changed: {label}, from {before} to {after}.

source.one: {count} input changed together — {list} — so the move cannot be put down to any one of them.
source.other: {count} inputs changed together — {list} — so the move cannot be put down to any one of them.

forecast.list.intro.source: The statistical model. Not the founder’s view, and not the community’s.

forecast.list.none.source: The model has no forecast for these matches.

source.one: {count} of these {total} matches has no model forecast.
source.other: {count} of these {total} matches have no model forecast.

powerIndex.unreachable.source: The Power Index service could not be reached, so no index can be shown.

powerIndex.none.source: No Power Index is available for this match.

powerIndex.stamp.source: Formula {formula}, computed {time}. 0–100 is this team’s standing in its competition, not a probability.

powerIndex.partlyMeasured.source: {percent} of the index was measurable. Not included: {list}.

notifications.friends.intro.source: When a friend predicts a match you follow or predicted too. It says that they predicted, never what, and only if their own privacy setting lets you see their predictions.

notifications.friends.predicted.source: A friend predicted a match you follow or predicted

notifications.editorial.intro.source: The founder's analysis of the matches you follow, and the review of any analysis you submit.

notifications.editorial.founder.source: The founder publishes an analysis of a match you follow

notifications.editorial.reviewed.source: An analysis I submitted is reviewed

notifications.editorial.eligible.source: A member newly meets the contributor requirements (administrators)

source.one: Only scorers whose recorded minutes reach {count} minute.
source.other: Only scorers whose recorded minutes reach {count} minutes.

source.one: {count} scorer is left out because the feed did not send minutes for every match they played, so the record cannot show they reached it.
source.other: {count} scorers are left out because the feed did not send minutes for every match they played, so the record cannot show they reached it.

competition.leaders.noneReach.source: No scorer's recorded minutes reach this floor.

team.manager.noCoach.source: No manager shown: the team's latest line-up names no coach.

team.manager.noLineup.source: No manager shown: no line-up of this team is stored yet.

team.squad.minutes.source: Minutes are for this team in the competitions above, from the feed's per-player figures: "at least" where some matches have none.

saved.intro.source: Stories you saved, newest first. Only you can see this list, and it goes when your account does. Each is the publisher's headline and a link to their original.

saved.empty.source: You have not saved a story yet. Save one from News or from a story's page.

saved.unreachable.source: Your saved list cannot be reached right now, so nothing can be shown.

saved.dropped.source: this publisher is no longer carried here and their stories went with them, so this one cannot be shown.

saved.unavailable.source: this story is no longer held here.

saved.signIn.source: Sign in to save this story.

leaderboard.language.note.source: A member's language is the one they chose for FMIP in Settings. It is not public, so this board shows only members whose prediction history you may see.

competition.boards.noAssists.source: No goal of this season names an assist yet.

competition.boards.noCleanSheets.source: No goalkeeper on our line-ups has kept a clean sheet yet this season.

competition.boards.noCards.source: No card is recorded for this season yet.

competition.boards.noneReach.source: No player's recorded minutes reach this floor.

source.one: {count} player is left out because the feed did not send minutes for every match they played, so the record cannot show they reached the floor.
source.other: {count} players are left out because the feed did not send minutes for every match they played, so the record cannot show they reached the floor.

rules.englishOnly.source: The rules are published in English, the language they were approved in.

rules.pendingIntro.source: This version is newer than the one you accepted. Read it first: once you accept it, it applies to you from then on. Until then the version you accepted before still applies, and nothing you wrote is hidden.

rules.outcome.accepted.source: Accepted. This version now applies to you.

rules.outcome.newer.source: A newer version was published while you were reading. This is it: read it before accepting.

rules.outcome.signedOut.source: Sign in to accept the rules.

rules.outcome.failed.source: The acceptance did not go through. Please try again shortly.

rules.prompt.source: The platform rules have a new version. Until you accept it, the version you accepted before still applies to you, and nothing you wrote is hidden.
